arcades.info_text: Entrance on the ground floor off of Chuo dori, next to the pachinko parlor entrance. Take the escalators up to the 6th & 7th floors through the Don Quijote. Vending machines and restrooms are on the 6th floor, all the games are on the 7th floor. There is a change machine and game card dispenser next to the escalators. / The machines are for the most part in excellent condition, most games are also 100 yen per play, even for the newer ones. / The staff is very serious about their "No Photos, No Videos" rule. Signs are clearly marked around the arcade and staff frequently patrols the gaming floor to enforce it. They usually don't say anything if you're just taking a photo of your score, but you should ask permission before filming or photographing the game room.
